title: ToolDescriptor
description: Owned, JSON-serializable tool descriptor matching `schemas/tools.v1.json` and `ashift tools --json`.

params_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's `params` object.

params_schema.title: InfoParams
params_schema.description:
Parameters for `pdf.info`.

`pdf.info` takes no parameters (`{}`) and rejects any unknown fields.

tools.summary: Inspect PDF version, page count, encryption status, geometry, metadata, and structural features.

outline.description: How bookmarks (`/Outlines`) from the input files are combined (`"per-file"` by default).

page_labels.description: How `/PageLabels` are combined across inputs (`"renumber"` by default).

MergeOutlineMode.description: Outline (bookmark) handling strategy when merging multiple PDFs (`pdf.merge`).

oneOf.description: Preserve existing bookmark trees from each input file with updated destination offsets.
Create one top-level bookmark entry per input file titled with the input file stem.
Omit outlines from the merged document.

MergePageLabelsMode.description: Page label handling strategy when merging multiple PDFs (`pdf.merge`).

oneOf.description: Preserve per-document `/PageLabels` number trees at each input file's starting page offset.
Renumber pages sequentially from `1` across the merged document.

tools.summary: Merge two or more PDF documents into a single PDF.

every.description: Number of pages per output chunk when `mode == "every"` (`>= 1`).

max_bytes.description: Target maximum byte size per output part when `mode == "size"` (`>= 1`).

oneOf.description: Split into one output PDF per page range in `ranges`.
Split into chunks of `every` consecutive pages.
Split at top-level or `level`-depth bookmark (`/Outlines`) boundaries.
Split so each output chunk stays at or below `max_bytes`.
Split on content-empty separator pages (pages with no drawing operators or only whitespace).

tools.summary: Split a PDF document into multiple part PDFs by page ranges, interval, bookmarks, size, or blank separators.

pages.description: 1-based page range selection to extract (duplicates allowed and kept in order).

tools.summary: Extract selected pages from a PDF document into a new PDF.

pages.description: 1-based page range selection to delete (must leave at least 1 page in the document).

tools.summary: Delete selected pages from a PDF document while keeping at least one remaining page.

oneOf.description: Interleave front and back duplex scan stacks (`1, N, 2, N-1, ...`).
Place all odd-numbered pages first followed by all even-numbered pages.

ReorderSpec.description:
Reorder specification: either a named preset (`"reverse"`, `"duplex-interleave"`,
`"odd-then-even"`) or an explicit 1-based [`PageRange`] sequence.

anyOf.description: Explicit 1-based page range or sequence (duplicates allowed and kept in order).

tools.summary: Reorder PDF pages using an explicit page range sequence or a named preset (reverse, duplex-interleave, odd-then-even).

reverse_second.description: Whether pages from the second input PDF should be taken in reverse order (`false` by default).

tools.summary: Interleave pages alternately from two PDF documents, optionally reversing the second document.

after.description: 1-based pages after which to insert blank pages (`"all"` by default).

count.description: Number of blank pages to insert at each selected position (`1` by default, `>= 1`).

size.description: Blank page dimensions (`"same"` by default, or a named/custom paper size).

BlankPageSize.description: Blank page size specification for `pdf.insert_blank`: `"same"` or a [`PaperSize`].

anyOf.description: Match the dimensions of the page after which the blank page is inserted.
Explicit standard or custom paper dimensions.

CustomPaperSize.description: Custom paper size specified as `{ w, h }` in PDF points (`1 pt = 1/72 inch`).

PaperSize.description:
Paper size specification: either a named standard paper (`"A4"`, `"Letter"`, etc.) or custom
`{ w, h }` dimensions in PDF points.

anyOf.description: Custom paper dimensions `{ w, h }` in PDF points.

SamePageSize.description: Marker variant for matching the adjacent page's size (`"same"`).

oneOf.description: Match the width and height of the reference page.

StandardPaper.description: Named ISO and North American standard paper sizes (`docs/tools.md`).

tools.summary: Insert blank pages of matching or specified paper size after selected PDF pages.

angle.description: Clockwise rotation delta in degrees (`90`, `180`, `270`, or `-90`).

pages.description: 1-based pages to rotate (`"all"` by default; duplicate pages are rejected).

tools.summary: Rotate selected PDF pages by a multiple of 90 degrees without re-rendering.

box.description: Crop box coordinates in PDF points or `"trim-whitespace-later"`.

target.description: Target page box to set (`"crop"` by default, or `"media"`).

oneOf.description: Placeholder marker for rendering-based whitespace auto-crop.

CropBoxSpec.description:
Crop box specification for `pdf.crop`: explicit `{ left, bottom, right, top }` or
`"trim-whitespace-later"`.

anyOf.description: Explicit rectangle `{ left, bottom, right, top }` in PDF points.

CropRect.description: Explicit crop rectangle coordinates `{ left, bottom, right, top }` in PDF points.

CropTarget.description: Target PDF page box updated by `pdf.crop`.

tools.summary: Set the CropBox or MediaBox of selected PDF pages in points.

to.description: Target paper size (`"A4"` by default, or `"Letter"`, `"Legal"`, `"A3"`, `"A5"`, `{w, h}`).

CustomPaperSize.description: Custom paper size specified as `{ w, h }` in PDF points (`1 pt = 1/72 inch`).

PaperSize.description:
Paper size specification: either a named standard paper (`"A4"`, `"Letter"`, etc.) or custom
`{ w, h }` dimensions in PDF points.

anyOf.description: Custom paper dimensions `{ w, h }` in PDF points.

oneOf.description: Uniformly scale content to fit inside the target sheet while preserving aspect ratio.
Uniformly scale content to cover the entire target sheet while preserving aspect ratio.
Non-uniformly stretch content horizontally and vertically to fill the target sheet.

StandardPaper.description: Named ISO and North American standard paper sizes (`docs/tools.md`).

tools.summary: Scale selected PDF pages to a target paper size using Form XObjects.

params_schema.title: SinglePageParams
params_schema.description:
Parameters for `pdf.single_page`.

`pdf.single_page` takes no parameters (`{}`) and rejects any unknown fields.

tools.summary: Concatenate all pages of a PDF document vertically into a single continuous page.

expand.description: Whether to expand the page `/MediaBox` so rotated corners are not clipped (`true` by default).

pages.description: 1-based pages whose content streams should be rotated (`"all"` by default).

tools.summary: Rotate PDF page content by an arbitrary angle using a Form XObject and transform matrix.

object_streams.description: Whether to expand `/ObjStm` object streams (`"expand"` by default).

pages.description: Optional 1-based page selection whose streams should be decompressed (all streams when omitted).

ObjectStreamsMode.description: How compressed object streams (`/Type /ObjStm`) are handled by `pdf.decompress`.

oneOf.description: Keep object stream grouping if present.
Expand all compressed object streams into top-level indirect objects (`"expand"`, default).

tools.summary: Decompress PDF streams and expand object streams within decoded-size limits.

borders.description: Whether to draw thin border hairlines around each placed page cell (`false` by default).

margins_pt.description: Outer and cell margins in PDF points (`0.0` by default).

order.description: Grid cell filling order (`"row"` by default, or `"column"`).

per_sheet.description: Number of input pages placed on each output sheet (`2` by default; `2 | 4 | 6 | 8 | 9 | 16`).

sheet.description: Target output sheet size (`"A4"` by default).

CustomPaperSize.description: Custom paper size specified as `{ w, h }` in PDF points (`1 pt = 1/72 inch`).

GridOrder.description: Grid cell ordering for multi-cell layout tools (`pdf.nup`, `pdf.divide_pages`).

MarginSides.description: Explicit per-side margins in PDF points (`top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`).

Margins.description:
Page margin specification in PDF points: either a uniform non-negative number or per-side
`{ top, right, bottom, left }`.

anyOf.description: Uniform margin on all four sides in PDF points (`>= 0`).

PaperSize.description:
Paper size specification: either a named standard paper (`"A4"`, `"Letter"`, etc.) or custom
`{ w, h }` dimensions in PDF points.

anyOf.description: Custom paper dimensions `{ w, h }` in PDF points.

StandardPaper.description: Named ISO and North American standard paper sizes (`docs/tools.md`).

tools.summary: Place multiple PDF pages onto each output sheet in an N-up grid layout.

binding.description: Spine binding direction (`"left"` by default, or `"right"`).

creep_pt.description: Per-signature inner margin creep compensation in PDF points (`0.0` by default, `>= 0`).

sheet.description: Output sheet paper size (`"A4"` by default).

BookletBinding.description: Binding edge for saddle-stitch booklet imposition (`pdf.booklet`).

CustomPaperSize.description: Custom paper size specified as `{ w, h }` in PDF points (`1 pt = 1/72 inch`).

PaperSize.description:
Paper size specification: either a named standard paper (`"A4"`, `"Letter"`, etc.) or custom
`{ w, h }` dimensions in PDF points.

anyOf.description: Custom paper dimensions `{ w, h }` in PDF points.

StandardPaper.description: Named ISO and North American standard paper sizes (`docs/tools.md`).

tools.summary: Impose PDF pages into saddle-stitch booklet spreads padded to a multiple of 4.

overlay_pages.description: Overlay page pairing mode (`"first"` by default, `"cycle"`, or `"matching"`).

pages.description: 1-based base pages to apply the overlay onto (`"all"` by default).

position.description: Layer ordering relative to the base page (`"over"` by default, or `"under"`).

OverlayPagesMode.description: How pages from the second (overlay) PDF are paired with target pages in the base PDF.

oneOf.description: Apply page 1 of the overlay PDF to every selected base page (`"first"`, default).
Cycle through the overlay PDF's pages repeatedly across the selected base pages.
Pair page `k` of the overlay PDF with page `k` of the base PDF (when present).

OverlayPosition.description: Z-order placement of the overlay relative to the base page content.

oneOf.description: Paint the overlay above the base page content (`"over"`, default).
Paint the overlay beneath the base page content (`"under"`).

tools.summary: Overlay or underlay pages from a second PDF onto selected pages of a base PDF.

cols.description: Number of horizontal columns to divide each page into (`1..=8`, `2` by default).

order.description: Emission order of subdivided page tiles (`"row"` by default, or `"column"`).

rows.description: Number of vertical rows to divide each page into (`1..=8`, `2` by default).

GridOrder.description: Grid cell ordering for multi-cell layout tools (`pdf.nup`, `pdf.divide_pages`).

tools.summary: Subdivide each selected PDF page into a cols by rows grid of cropped cell pages.

crop_marks.description: Whether to draw corner crop marks on each tile sheet (`true` by default).

overlap_mm.description: Tile overlap margin in millimetres (`10.0` by default, `>= 0.0`).

scale.description: Enlargement scale factor (`> 1.0`, mutually optional with `tiles`).

sheet.description: Output tile sheet paper size (`"A4"` by default).

tiles.description: Explicit tile grid `{ cols, rows }` across which each page is enlarged.

CustomPaperSize.description: Custom paper size specified as `{ w, h }` in PDF points (`1 pt = 1/72 inch`).

PaperSize.description:
Paper size specification: either a named standard paper (`"A4"`, `"Letter"`, etc.) or custom
`{ w, h }` dimensions in PDF points.

anyOf.description: Custom paper dimensions `{ w, h }` in PDF points.

PosterizeTiles.description: Explicit tile grid dimensions `{ cols, rows }` for `pdf.posterize`.

StandardPaper.description: Named ISO and North American standard paper sizes (`docs/tools.md`).

tools.summary: Enlarge selected PDF pages across multiple tiled output sheets with overlap and crop marks.

remove.description: Metadata field keys to remove from `/Info` and XMP `/Metadata`.

set.description: Metadata fields to set or overwrite in `/Info` and XMP `/Metadata`.

strip_all.description: When `true`, strip all `/Info` and XMP `/Metadata` entries before applying `set` (`false` by default).

MetadataFields.description: Document metadata fields to set or update (`pdf.metadata`).

tools.summary: Set, remove, or strip PDF /Info dictionary and XMP metadata fields.

oneOf.description: Export the document's bookmark tree (`/Outlines`) as a JSON artifact.
Replace the document's `/Outlines` hierarchy with the tree in `json`.
Generate a bookmark hierarchy automatically from detected document headings.

OutlineNode.description: A single bookmark node in a `pdf.outline` hierarchy.

children.description: Nested child bookmarks under this node.

tools.summary: Export, import, clear, or generate PDF outline bookmarks from headings.

names.description: Optional attachment filenames to filter on for `"extract"` or `"remove"`.

oneOf.description: List embedded file attachments as JSON.
Embed additional input files into the PDF `/EmbeddedFiles` name tree.
Extract embedded attachments as output artifacts.
Remove embedded attachments matching `names` (or all attachments when `names` is omitted).

tools.summary: List, add, extract, or remove embedded file attachments in a PDF.

ranges.description: Ordered list of page-label ranges (`>= 1` entry).

PageLabelRange.description: A single page-label numbering range starting at 1-based page `from`.

from.description: 1-based first page index where this numbering range begins (`>= 1`).

prefix.description: Optional label prefix prepended before the numeric portion (PDF `/P`).

start.description: Starting numeric value for this range (`1` by default, `>= 1`; PDF `/St`).

oneOf.description: Uppercase Roman numerals (`I, II, III, ...`; PDF `/S /R`).
Lowercase Roman numerals (`i, ii, iii, ...`; PDF `/S /r`).
Prefix only with no numeric portion (PDF `/S` omitted).

tools.summary: Rewrite the PDF /PageLabels number tree across 1-based page ranges.

display_doc_title.description: Whether the window title bar should display the document `/Title` (`/ViewerPreferences /DisplayDocTitle`).

fit_window.description: Whether to resize the document window to fit the first page (`/ViewerPreferences /FitWindow`).

hide_toolbar.description: Whether to hide the viewer application's toolbars (`/ViewerPreferences /HideToolbar`).

open_page.description: 1-based page number to open initially (`/OpenAction` destination, `>= 1`).

page_layout.description: Initial page layout (`/PageLayout` on the Catalog).

page_mode.description: Initial navigation panel mode (`/PageMode` on the Catalog).

oneOf.description: Display one page at a time (`/SinglePage`).
Display the pages in one continuous column (`/OneColumn`).
Display the pages in two columns, with odd-numbered pages on the left (`/TwoColumnLeft`).
Display the pages in two columns, with odd-numbered pages on the right (`/TwoColumnRight`).
Display two pages at a time, with odd-numbered pages on the left (`/TwoPageLeft`).
Display two pages at a time, with odd-numbered pages on the right (`/TwoPageRight`).
Neither document outline nor thumbnail images visible (`/UseNone`).

tools.summary: Configure PDF catalog /ViewerPreferences, /PageLayout, /PageMode, and /OpenAction.

view.description: Initial collection view when `action == "create"` (`"details"` by default, or `"tile"`).

oneOf.description: Package multiple input files into a PDF collection (`/Collection`) with a cover page.
List embedded files in a PDF portfolio as JSON.
Extract all files from a PDF portfolio.
Multi-column details table view (`"details"`, default; PDF `/D`).

tools.summary: Create, list, or extract a PDF portfolio (/Collection) with embedded files.

LayersAction.description: Action performed on PDF optional content groups (`/OCProperties`) by `pdf.layers`.

oneOf.description: List optional content groups (layers) and their default visibility as JSON.
Set the default visibility (`ON` or `OFF`) of the layers named in `names`.
Remove the layers named in `names` and their marked content from the PDF.

tools.summary: List, toggle default visibility, or remove Optional Content Group (OCG) layers.

InputArity.description: Required input file count for a tool (`docs/tools.md` §3).

oneOf.description: Between `min` and `max` input files (inclusive) are required (`1 <= min <= max`).

max.description: Maximum number of input files (`>= min`).

Tier.description: Access tier of a registered tool (`docs/tools.md` §10).

oneOf.description: Requires a plan that grants Pro access (`Pro`, `Team`, `Enterprise`).

ToolGroup.description: Functional category of a registered document tool (`docs/tools.md` §2).

oneOf.description: Page and document structure manipulation (`pdf.info`, `pdf.merge`, `pdf.rotate`, etc.).
Multi-artifact or specialized document conversions (`pdf.render`, `image.to_pdf`, etc.).
File size reduction, stream recompression, linearization, repair.
Stamps, page numbers, headers/footers, watermarks, background overlays.
Optical character recognition, deskewing, blank page removal.
Highlights, notes, freehand ink, geometric markups, comment flattening.
AcroForm field inspection, filling, creation, and flattening.
PAdES digital signing, timestamping, and signature verification.
True object-stream and raster redaction with verification report.
Visual overlay comparison and semantic content comparison.
Stateless page-mode in-place edits and document-mode export helpers.
Offline-first summarization, Q&A with citations, translation, table extraction.
Batch recipe execution and folder watch automation.

ToolRuntime.description: Execution runtime environment supported by a tool (`docs/tools.md` §2).

oneOf.description: Local host execution (`ashift` CLI, local MCP, `apps/macos`).
